title: Show empty-cart message
body:
### summary

As a claimant, I want to see my empty list, so that I know where to start.

### completion_goal

1. [screenshot] state: cart is empty; expected: the "Your cart is empty" message and a Browse button
2. [api-trace] state: POST /cart with no items; expected: 422 with code cart.empty

### measure

criteria observed

### threshold

2 of 2

### scenario

Open the list with no items.

### environment

staging with seed data
